title: Leica Rugby 620 Grade Laser
summary:
The Rugby 620 adds manual slope in a single axis to the horizontal self-levelling of the Rugby 610, which is what drainage, ramps, driveways, and sloped formwork need.

Accuracy holds at +/- 2.2 mm at 30 m, self-levelling covers +/- 5 degrees, and the slope is set manually in one axis rather than dialled in like the 680. Rod Eye 120 and 140 receivers give a working diameter of 800 m and 1,100 m, and the battery runs up to 120 hours on Li-ion. IP67.

It is the choice when the work has a fall in it but the grade is set by hand rather than by machine.
specs: Accuracy +/- 2.2 mm at 30 m (+/- 3/32 inch at 100 ft)
Self-levelling range +/- 5 degrees with manual slope in one axis
635 nm red laser, Class 1, 10 rps rotation
Maximum working diameter 800 m with Rod Eye 120 / 120G; 1,100 m with Rod Eye 140 / 160
Up to 120 h on Li-ion, 60 h on alkaline
